purpose: Original AI-generated artwork for English Brain Games; no official curriculum alignment is implied.

assets.description: Open books, winding tile track and lightning trophy
Animal and nature picture frames, camera and magnifier
Neutral geometric puzzle pieces; no scored answer highlighted
Glowing blue gift box, compass and blank clue cards

assets.use: Brain Battle cover and landing hero
assets.description: Lavender brain, book and strategy towers
Single recognizable elephant; question UI uses a neutral accessible description

delivery: Next Image optimizes cover illustrations for responsive viewports. Decorative covers have empty alt text; instructional question images retain descriptive non-answer alt text. Existing /elephant.svg references resolve to the generated scene in the renderer without modifying personal game copies or session snapshots. Active scored questions do not display decorative cover art.
